name: turn-changes
description: Lists the files the last turn changed in a pane, each with its diff a press away; /changes opens it (terminal)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this mod off without removing it. Takes effect at once.

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the pane at a turn's first edit, where the terminal is wide enough. Off, only /changes opens it.
